final: WITH c AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM member mb JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), d AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg FROM c) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - dept_avg AS diff_above_avg FROM d WHERE share > dept_avg ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
